item.title: RabbitMQ Notes
item.description: RabbitMQ # The fact that you have a Java consumer that works correctly points to either amqplib-easy, amqplib or your code as the culprit. Also, note that using a single queue in RabbitMQ is an anti-pattern as queues are the unit of concurrency in the broker. Link
